fields.label: Point of Contact
fields.description: Who the delegate intends to see — a doctor, a pharmacist, whoever this client's business goes through. Optional: a client with nobody on file is still plannable.

fields.label: Visit Type
fields.description: Scheduled = planned ahead as part of the week. Ad-hoc = raised by the delegate mid-week for a client the plan didn't cover; it still needs approval before they can check in.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why this unplanned client needs visiting. Required on Ad-hoc lines — it is the whole basis the manager approves on.

fields.label: Approval Status
fields.description: Set by the Delegate Manager during review. A line stays Pending until it is individually decided or swept up by a whole-plan approval.

fields.label: Manager Comment
fields.description: Why this particular line was rejected. Shown back to the delegate so they know what to fix before resubmitting.

fields.label: Visit Assignment
fields.description: The live Visit Assignment this line produced once approved. Empty until then — an unapproved plan line is not a visit the delegate can act on.
